theme_archetype.vibe: Old Money Tech, Book Bindery, Craftsmanship, Tactile

font_pairings.ui_heading: font-sans font-medium text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#A19E97]

spacing_and_layout.app_structure: Three-pane layout. Left: Book Hierarchy (Dark theme). Center: The Desk (Neutral Canvas) with centered Book Page. Right/Top: Floating Properties Toolbar.
spacing_and_layout.page_container: bg-[#F9F6F0] shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-[#1C1B19]/5 mx-auto relative overflow-hidden
spacing_and_layout.padding_rules: Use generous padding. Desk should have p-12 or p-20 to frame the book page.
spacing_and_layout.radius: Minimal. rounded-sm or rounded-none to emulate physical paper and structural editorial tools.

interactions_and_motion.drag_drop: Blocks on canvas should have subtle scale-up on drag (scale: 1.02).
interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Buttons and list items should transition background color smoothly. Focus states require ring-2 ring-[#9E4532] ring-offset-2.

components.buttons: Flat solid, slightly rounded (rounded-sm), crisp edges. Primary: bg-[#9E4532] text-[#F9F6F0] hover:bg-[#873B2A]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#D1CEC7] text-[#1C1B19].
components.sidebar: Dark mode. bg-[#1C1B19] text-[#F9F6F0] border-r border-[#2E2D2B]. Active page highlighted with bg-[#2E2D2B].
components.canvas_blocks: Text and image blocks require bounding boxes on hover/focus (border-dashed border-2 border-[#9E4532]/50). Resize handles at corners.
components.toolbars: Floating glass or solid pill. bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md shadow-md border border-[#D1CEC7] px-4 py-2 rounded-full.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based naming.

critical_steps: Set up Tailwind config with the specified colors and fonts (Cormorant Garamond and Outfit).
Implement a robust drag-and-drop canvas using react-rnd or framer-motion for absolute positioning of text/image blocks.
Ensure the book page dimensions reflect physical aspect ratios (e.g., A4 is 210x297, scale proportionally via aspect-ratio classes).
Do NOT use generic select inputs; use Shadcn UI customized with our stark/editorial theme.
Use html2canvas and jspdf for client-side PDF export.
Do not use generic SaaS layouts. The left sidebar must be dark and structural, while the main desk is warm, tactile, and spacious.
Implement data-testid on every clickable UI element.
Mock API functions locally (localStorage/IndexedDB or simple Node backend) if MongoDB integration requires bridging.
